canonicalCards.title: Organization Without Audio Change — Signal Flow
tradeoffs: The experiment may improve improve navigation while preserving every Output, insert, send, and automation relationship, but accidentally choosing Summing Stack, changing group links, or moving nonadjacent tracks unexpectedly.
A routing structure can be technically valid yet harder to understand, automate, solo, or export.
Shared processing can create cohesion, but it can also let one member dominate the complete path.
canonicalCards.userIntent: Use organization without changing audio to improve navigation while preserving every Output, insert, send, and automation relationship while preserving a reversible, intelligible signal path.
